limitations: Prior pass P6 left seven of eight governing_contract_link tuples at UNRESOLVED; purpose A row inclusion uses plausibly governing candidates (any disposition) rather than requiring ASSERTED, matching purpose epistemics that unresolved linkage must not silently drop qualifying rows.

identity_judgment and mechanical_identity_allowance disagree on several billing-to-contract pairs (e.g. Meridian, Northbridge); derivation treats identity_judgment as required and mechanical_identity_allowance as optional enrichment that may upgrade UNRESOLVED to SAME_ENTITY.
open_invoice stores invoice referent in column invoice_id; native invoice_id text is joined from invoice_record per P6 admission note.
Purpose DERIVED relations are not materialized in world.sqlite; derive_purposes.py projects them directly into purpose_ir/{a,b,c}/output.json.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Pure formatting; no semantic disposition. Each referent receives one deterministic purpose-prescribed identifier string.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over the union of CRM accounts, registry entities, and contracts compiled in world.sqlite.
derivations.deterministic_computation: UNION ALL of crm:<account_id>, registry:<company_number>, contract:<contract_id> from mechanical records; already registered and SUCCEEDED in world.sqlite.
derivations.required_premise: Mechanical source records exist for each referent receiving an identifier.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Deterministic normalization collapses exact legal-form variants to SAME_ENTITY without semantic review; explicit commercial_notes equivalences included.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over normalized name pairs drawn from compiled mechanical identifiers; not a closed-world claim over all possible aliases.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Normalize names (case, punctuation, Ltd/Limited, Inc.) and emit SAME_ENTITY for matching pairs plus explicit commercial_notes pairs; already SUCCEEDED in world.sqlite.
derivations.required_premise: Mechanical name fields from billing, CRM, registry, and contract headers.
derivations.optional_enrichment: None; this relation itself is optional enrichment for semantic identity_judgment downstream.

derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over invoice_record: every open-status invoice appears exactly once.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT invoice referent FROM invoice_record WHERE status = 'open'; already SUCCEEDED in world.sqlite.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_record.status copied verbatim from billing sources.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A analytical filter: projects ACCEPT dispositions for clause kinds in contracts/purpose_a.json allowed_kinds; REJECT and UNRESOLVED clause judgments are excluded.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Row coverage is the intersection of adjudicated ACCEPT tuples with purpose A allowed_kinds; completeness is relative to purpose policy, not closed-world negation over all contracts.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT contract, clause_kind FROM clause_kind_present WHERE disposition = 'ACCEPT' AND clause_kind IN purpose_a allowed_kinds.
derivations.required_premise: clause_kind_present ACCEPT for at least one purpose A acquisition kind on the contract.
blocking_unresolved_state: clause_kind_present.disposition = UNRESOLVED for all purpose A kinds on a contract blocks acquisition_relevant_clause membership for that contract
non_blocking_unresolved_state: clause_kind_present.disposition = REJECT is non-blocking for other kinds; contract may still qualify via a different ACCEPT acquisition kind

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Include invoice when an active governing-contract candidate carries at least one acquisition-relevant ACCEPT clause. Map billing-to-contract identity to association asserted (SAME_ENTITY) or unresolved; never omit a qualifying row solely for unresolved association.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every invoice with an active governing-contract candidate and acquisition-relevant ACCEPT clause must appear in purpose_ir/a/output.json, sorted by invoice_id.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Join invoice_record to governing_contract_link and contract_lifecycle (active=1); require EXISTS acquisition_relevant_clause; compute association from identity_judgment billing:<billed_name> to contract:<contract_id>, upgraded by mechanical_identity_allowance SAME_ENTITY when identity is UNRESOLVED.
derivations.required_premise: governing_contract_link candidate exists; contract_lifecycle.active = true; at least one acquisition-relevant clause_kind_present ACCEPT.
derivations.optional_enrichment: mechanical_identity_allowance SAME_ENTITY may upgrade UNRESOLVED identity_judgment to asserted association.
blocking_unresolved_state: no acquisition-relevant ACCEPT clause on governing contract
non_blocking_unresolved_state: governing_contract_link.disposition = UNRESOLVED still permits inclusion using the plausibly governing candidate
identity_judgment UNRESOLVED (without mechanical upgrade) yields association = unresolved but row remains

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Emit directed identity links for required commercial wiring; orient pairs by class_rank (billing < contract < crm < registry). Map SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, UNRESOLVED to purpose output; REJECT maps to DISTINCT.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Cover required relationship connectivity (CRM, billing, contract, registry candidates per C2 generation); not an all-pairs Cartesian product.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Project all identity_judgment pairs oriented by class_rank; merge mechanical_identity_allowance SAME_ENTITY for pairs absent or UNRESOLVED in identity_judgment; map dispositions per contracts/purpose_b.json.
derivations.required_premise: identity_judgment tuple exists for each required wiring pair generated in world construction.
derivations.optional_enrichment: mechanical_identity_allowance adds or strengthens SAME_ENTITY on UNRESOLVED pairs (e.g. billing-to-contract for Meridian and Northbridge).
non_blocking_unresolved_state: absence of SAME_ENTITY is not DISTINCT; DISTINCT requires positive establishing evidence

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose C two-part test: current commercial relationship (open invoice on link OR active auto_renewal/rolling_term) AND obligation kind present. status = dependent only when identity chain is confidently SAME_ENTITY; otherwise status = unresolved.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Emit a row for each active contract meeting the dependency candidate test; mark unresolved rather than omit when identity joins fail.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each active contract with ACCEPT obligation kind in {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term}, test current relationship via open_invoice join or term clause; set status dependent when billing-to-contract identity is SAME_ENTITY (with optional mechanical upgrade) and open-invoice identity chain is confident.
derivations.required_premise: contract_lifecycle.active = true; at least one purpose C obligation kind ACCEPT; current commercial relationship satisfied.
derivations.optional_enrichment: mechanical_identity_allowance may resolve identity UNRESOLVED sufficient for status = dependent.
blocking_unresolved_state: no purpose C obligation kind ACCEPT on contract
no current commercial relationship (no open invoice on link and no auto_renewal/rolling_term ACCEPT)
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED on billing-to-contract or open-invoice chain yields status = unresolved
governing_contract_link UNRESOLVED does not suppress row when plausibly governing candidate supports open invoice join

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Sorted subset of purpose C obligation vocabulary present with ACCEPT disposition on each dependency row contract.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: For each commercial_dependency_row, list all ACCEPT obligation kinds on that contract.
derivations.deterministic_computation: JOIN clause_kind_present to commercial_dependency_row on contract WHERE disposition = ACCEPT AND clause_kind IN {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term}; sort ascending.
derivations.required_premise: commercial_dependency_row exists; clause_kind_present ACCEPT for obligation kind.
blocking_unresolved_state: clause_kind_present UNRESOLVED for an obligation kind excludes that kind from the sorted list
non_blocking_unresolved_state: commercial_dependency_row.status = unresolved still carries obligation_kinds from ACCEPT world judgments

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Open invoices linked to the dependency row contract via governing link; list may be empty when relationship is contract-only (auto_renewal/rolling_term).
derivations.completeness_assumptions: All open invoices plausibly governed by the row contract are listed, sorted by invoice_id.
derivations.deterministic_computation: JOIN open_invoice to governing_contract_link and invoice_record for each commercial_dependency_row contract; emit native invoice_id with prefix stripped per purpose C rendering.
derivations.required_premise: open_invoice and governing_contract_link share invoice referent on row contract.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Identity confidence may be used to filter open invoices to counterparty-consistent rows when multiple billing names exist; current world has one billed name per governing link.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: empty open_invoice_ids when current relationship satisfied solely by auto_renewal or rolling_term
governing_contract_link UNRESOLVED still lists open invoices on plausibly governing candidate
